title: Surface code memory, distance 3, both bases
description: Three rounds of two distance-3 rotated surface-code patches in lockstep, one a Z memory and one an X memory (34 ions: 18 data, 16 ancillas, reset and reused every round), then the data read out, each patch in its own basis. Ranked with every Goal 1 code by the logical error rate per round per logical qubit under qccd-noise@2, with Helios-class physics in which every number is cited.
